mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops > 2% in a month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by the RSAFS index, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS drops > 1% in a month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment, as measured by the PAYEMS index, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by > 200k jobs in a month but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts, as measured by the HOUST index, signals an overextended housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the sector mean-reverts.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 20% above its 12-month moving average but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the CPIAUCSL index, signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 3% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
